aiOverview.content: The 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification process, which determines 45 of the 48 finalists, ran from September 7, 2023, to March 31, 2026. Key final matches included UEFA playoffs in March 2026, with teams like Italy, Croatia, and Portugal securing spots for the tournament in Canada, Mexico, and the USA.2026 FIFA World Cup Qualifying HighlightsUEFA (Europe): Group winners and playoff winners (concluded March 2026) saw top teams like France, Germany, Spain, England, and Portugal secure qualification.CONMEBOL (South America): Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Uruguay secured spots, with Bolivia entering a play-off.Intercontinental Play-offs: These concluded in March 2026, involving teams from various confederations vying for the last spots.Finalized Field: All 48 teams (including hosts Canada, Mexico, and the USA) are finalized for the tournament starting June 11, 2026.Key Final Play-off Results (March 2026)March 26: Italy 2-0 N. Ireland; Wales 1-1 (2-4 pen) Bosnia; Ukraine 1-3 Sweden.March 31: Bosnia 1-1 (4-1 pen) Italy; Sweden 3-2 Poland; Kosovo 0-1 Türkiye; Czechia 2-2 (3-1 pen) Denmark.For full, up-to-the-minute scores and schedules, you can view the official FIFA World Cup 26™ Qualifiers site or the UEFA European Qualifiers page.
